ain-Kana.original_value: Commons オㇿ タ ノカ オルㇱペ アコピシ エアイカㇷ゚.
ain-Kana.backtranslation: It was not possible to inquire at Commons about the image information.
ain-Kana.rationale: The Kana and Latin spellings correspond, including final consonant signs and handakuten, but script correctness does not validate the clause. The dictionary treats kopisi principally as asking someone; the bare noka oruspe phrase does not independently establish an about-metadata argument. That paraphrase may also mean image story/information rather than metadata. Do not accept a word-for-word assembled sentence without resolving both issues.
ain-Kana.script_convention: Kana target is respected; Commons is a permitted Latin proper name. Full small-kana/combining-mark shaping is still untested.
ain-Kana.scope_check: Intended to express query/request failure, but the exact non-English sentence has not been established as adequate; do not implement this candidate as accepted.
ain-Kana.review_limit: Independent model/source-assisted linguistic review only; no native-speaker certification. Rendering and runtime behavior were not tested by this review.
ain-Kana.required_resolution: Confirm a natural Ainu machine-query construction, its queried object/source arguments and a metadata-specific descriptive term; then align both scripts.

mnc-Mong.backtranslation: Could not inquire of Commons for the image information.
mnc-Mong.rationale: The text is genuinely Manchu-script and the ability/negative morphology is compositionally plausible. The primary grammar supports asking but uses de for the person asked in one worked example; ci as the source of this API inquiry still needs checking. nirugan i mejige is broader image information/news and has not been shown to identify metadata. Suffix-i shaping/spacing also requires actual-script review.
mnc-Mong.script_convention: Manchu letters occur within the Mongolian Unicode block; this is not a Mongolian-language substitution. Suffix separation needs review.

bo.rationale: The failure-to-succeed predicate is plausible Tibetan, but the proposed meta-plus-information term and computing inquiry phrase were not substantiated well enough. The upstream Tibetan MediaWiki catalogue offers a different metadata term; it is evidence of variation, not grounds to copy it. Full sentence naturalness remains uncertain.

mn-Mong.original_value: Commons ᠤᠨ ᠮᠧᠲ᠋ᠠ ᠥᠭᠭᠦᠭᠳᠡᠯ ᠦᠨ ᠬᠦᠰᠡᠯᠲᠡ ᠠᠮᠵᠢᠯᠲᠠ ᠦᠭᠡᠢ ᠪᠣᠯᠪᠠ᠃
mn-Mong.backtranslation: The request for Commons metadata was unsuccessful.
mn-Mong.rationale: The traditional-script proposal cannot be accepted merely by converting the Cyrillic meaning. The technical loan spelling, traditional lexical forms and full inflection remain insufficiently checked. Ordinary spaces before suffixes also bypass script-sensitive suffix shaping. Unicode 17 describes MVS for this role and legacy NNBSP compatibility, so a blind whitespace replacement is not enough.
mn-Mong.script_convention: Traditional Mongolian target is respected at block level, but suffix-gap encoding and shaping are not approved.

ryu.original_value: Commonsぬメタデータぬ問い合わせー、ないびらんたん。
ryu.backtranslation: The query for Commons metadata could not be carried out.
ryu.rationale: The proper name and modern loans remain recognizable and nu is plausible, but the nominal 問い合わせー plus ないびらんたん construction has not been established as a natural failed-query sentence. Generic negative/past examples do not validate the nominal connection or rule out a Japanese calque. The exact negative-form example cited by the proposer could not be independently recovered from the extractable paper text.
